title: Stateful minimal valid SendRRData
purpose: Repair the minimal SendRRData concept by preceding it with RegisterSession and using the smallest complete valid CPF plus CIP Message Router request.
expected_behavior: After registration, the target should parse SendRRData, process the documented Null Address and Unconnected Data CPF items, and dispatch the 6-byte CIP request or reject it cleanly at the application layer.
constraints_preserved: SendRRData session handle is nonzero and consistent across the stateful pair.
Encapsulation length is 0x0014 matching 20 bytes of command-specific data.
Interface handle is 4-byte zero and timeout is 2-byte zero.
Null Address Item type is 0x0000 with length 0.
Unconnected Data Item type is 0x00b2 with length 0x0006 matching the CIP bytes.
CIP request uses service 0x01 and path size 0x02 with exactly four request-path bytes.
issue_safety_notes: This preserves the sensitive explicit-message surface while avoiding forged path sizes or truncated item data described in issue 582.
